title: Storage backend abstraction with two implementations
task: In package `blob` I want an abstraction for storage backends with `Save(key string, data []byte) error` and `Load(key string) ([]byte, error)`, plus an in-memory implementation and a filesystem one that writes files under a directory. Callers should only ever see the abstraction. Name things so a reader of a call site does not need to decode any marker to tell the abstraction from an implementation. Tests should run both implementations through the same cases, including a missing key.
